articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Small-caps rip, defensive stocks, silver & gold: Market Takeaways. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre breaks down the biggest market themes from today’s trading day, including the gains seen across small-cap stocks, defensive positions in large-cap sectors, and the moves in silver (SI=F), gold prices (GC=F). and chip stocks.
